caption: A top-down photo of a bowl of Japanese ramen with deep red spicy broth with chili oil floating on top. Wheat noodles are submerged in the broth. A soup spoon rests in the bowl. The bowl sits on a table, shot in warm natural light, appetizing food photography.

segments_info.text: The table surface behind the ramen bowl, softly out of focus.
The deep red spicy broth with chili oil floating on top, with wheat noodles just under the surface.
A ceramic ramen bowl seen from above, its glazed rim catching the light.
A Chinese soup spoon resting in the bowl.
